content:
Each glue contact hides 2 faces. To maximize surface area, minimize glue contacts while keeping all 30 cubes connected.

A connected arrangement of 30 cubes needs at least \(30-1=29\) face-to-face contacts. This is achievable, for example, by gluing the cubes in a chain.

So the maximum surface area is
\[
6(30)-2(29)=180-58=122.
\]

\[
\boxed{122}
\]
